pages.ld_description:
The timeless Classic Record Player by Fisher Price is back. The design, which has been around since the 1970s, includes five double-sided records for kids to play on the wind-up turntable. With familiar kids’ tunes, including Humpty Dumpty and Jack and Jill, it’s sure to inspire a sing song and a knees up too. Once the disco winds down, the records can be stored inside the player, safe and secure for the next party.
Featuring a fresh design which incorporates elegant illustrations giving it a vintage feel, children will love to explore the musical toy as they pretend and play. With a turntable and a needle that replicates a vintage record player, this retro toy grows with your child as they develop. Made with high quality, the Fisher Price Classics line resonates with both parents and grandparents who grew up with these toys.
Comes with 5 double sided records.
Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
Suitable for ages 18 months+
